mapper.sql: FROM chat_message m JOIN chat_session s ON s.merchant_id=m.merchant_id AND s.id=m.session_id WHERE AND m.merchant_id=#{owner.merchantId} AND m.session_id=#{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT AND m.status='COMPLETED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_message a WHERE a.merchant_id=m.merchant_id AND a.session_id=m.session_id AND a.run_id=m.run_id AND a.sender_type='ASSISTANT' AND a.status='COMPLETED') ORDER BY m.message_seq DESC LIMIT #{size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (id,merchant_id,session_id,message_seq,sender_type,sender_account_id,client_message_id, content,status,run_id,error_code,prompt_version,model_service_label,model_name,input_tokens,output_tokens,created_at,completed_at) SELECT #{message.id},#{message.merchantId},#{message.sessionId},#{message.messageSeq},#{message.senderType}, #{message.senderAccountId},#{message.clientMessageId},#{message.content},#{message.status},#{message.runId}, #{message.errorCode},#{message.promptVersion},#{message.modelServiceLabel},#{message.modelName}, #{message.inputTokens},#{message.outputTokens},#{message.createdAt},#{message.completedAt} FROM chat_session s WHERE AND s.id=#{message.sessionId} AND s.merchant_id=#{message.merchantId} AND s.active_run_id=#{message.runId} AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND ((#{message.senderType}='USER' AND #{message.senderAccountId}=#{owner.accountId} AND #{message.messageSeq}=s.next_message_seq-2) OR (#{message.senderType}='ASSISTANT' AND #{message.messageSeq}=s.next_message_seq-1))
mapper.select: SELECT AND m.message_seq > #{afterSeq} ORDER BY m.message_seq ASC LIMIT #{pageSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message m JOIN chat_session s ON s.merchant_id=m.merchant_id AND s.id=m.session_id SET m.status=#{status},m.content=#{content},m.error_code=#{errorCode},m.input_tokens=#{inputTokens}, m.output_tokens=#{outputTokens},m.completed_at=#{now},m.sources_json=NULL WHERE AND m.merchant_id=#{owner.merchantId} AND m.session_id=#{sessionId} AND m.id=#{messageId} AND m.run_id=#{runId} AND s.active_run_id=#{runId} AND m.sender_type='ASSISTANT' AND m.status IN ('STARTED','STREAMING') AND ((#{status}='TIMED_OUT' AND s.run_deadline_at <= #{now}) OR (#{status} IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED','FAILED') AND s.run_deadline_at > #{now}))
